Excellencies, Excellencies, distinguished delegates, colleagues, friends, since we've got to the end of our first ordinary session of 2025, I wish to express my most sincere heartfelt thanks to all of you for your active and flexible participation in our deliberations. Throughout this week, we've engaged in substantive discussions and we've addressed essential issues for the work of the UNDP, UNFPA, and UNOPS. Similarly, we have adopted important documents for country programs, ensuring that cooperation with these agencies continues to respond to the needs on the ground. I wish to express my gratitude to the directors and the representatives of the UNDP, UNFPA, and UNOPS for their valuable contributions and their ongoing commitment to the work of these organizations. Similarly, I thank the Secretary of the Board for their tireless efforts and professional and very effective work in the preparation for and the management of this session. And I particularly congratulate, like I already did before, the facilitators of the different decisions that we've adopted. Your work was really a fundamental pillar of the work of this board. Aside from the facilitators, I wish to thank all delegations, each and every single delegation, because you've all participated actively and constructively in our discussions. It was a real pleasure to receive you at the Permanent Mission of Ecuador. Excellencies, distinguished delegates, colleagues, friends, as President, I wish to reassure you that you can count on our strong commitment to facilitate these procedures with a sense of openness, transparency, and with a spirit of collaboration. We will continue to work with you to ensure that the Executive Board can continue to play its role effectively looking towards the future. Like the Administrator of the UNDP shared us with regards to the constantly changing global context and the constantly changing context of development programs of the United Nations, there are— this is something that we can all trust in, and we should also trust in ourselves. As member states supporting this, and I think we can continue to ensure that the resources that are entrusted to us are made the most of to achieve the best impact, where each state can help to provide true changes and to ensure that our institutions remain effective and up to the task in the future and responsible. And the plan for June that we adopted today provides us a roadmap so that we continue to delve into further depth on these and other priority issues. I now close the first ordinary session of 2025 of the Executive Boards of the UNDP, UNFPA, and UNOPS. Thank you very much.
